feature_contract.normalization: ASCII camel-case/acronym boundaries, split punctuation/underscores, lowercase; exact implementation pinned by feature-contract digest and golden fixtures

numeric_features.name: sample_present
numeric_features.definition: 1 if any rows were profiled, otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: non_null_count_log
numeric_features.definition: log1p(non-null sampled values) / log1p(64), clipped to [0,1].

numeric_features.name: null_fraction
numeric_features.definition: SQL NULL count / sampled row count; 0 when no rows, with sample_present=0.

numeric_features.name: empty_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Zero-length non-null values / non-null values; 0 if denominator is zero.

numeric_features.name: mean_length_log
numeric_features.definition: log1p(mean returned byte length among non-null values) / log1p(256), clipped.

numeric_features.name: p95_length_log
numeric_features.definition: log1p(nearest-rank p95 returned byte length) / log1p(256), clipped; 0 when empty.

numeric_features.name: max_length_log
numeric_features.definition: log1p(max returned byte length) / log1p(256), clipped; 0 when empty.

numeric_features.name: sample_distinct_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Number of distinct complete non-null returned values / number of complete non-null values; zero if empty. Never export the values.

numeric_features.name: ascii_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Values consisting only of ASCII bytes / complete non-empty sampled values.

numeric_features.name: alphabetic_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Values consisting only of ASCII letters / complete non-empty sampled values.

numeric_features.name: numeric_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Values matching the pinned numeric-string parser / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: whitespace_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Values containing ASCII whitespace / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: at_sign_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Values containing @ / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: email_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Email-format recognizer hits / complete non-empty values; recognizer version is pinned.

numeric_features.name: phone_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Phone-format recognizer hits / complete non-empty values; no claim of number ownership.

numeric_features.name: uuid_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: UUID parser hits / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: ip_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: IPv4/IPv6 parser hits / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: url_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Absolute URL parser hits / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: iso_date_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Supported ISO date parser hits / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: payment_card_pattern_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Approved length/format/checksum recognizer hits / complete non-empty values; not a universal detector.

numeric_features.name: secret_marker_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Pinned protective secret-marker recognizer hits / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: high_entropy_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Pinned entropy heuristic hits / complete non-empty values; entropy alone does not label secrets.

numeric_features.name: json_object_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Complete JSON object parser hits / complete non-empty values; oversized JSON is excluded.

numeric_features.name: json_array_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Complete JSON array parser hits / complete non-empty values; oversized JSON is excluded.

numeric_features.name: multiline_fraction
numeric_features.definition: Values containing line breaks / complete non-empty values.

numeric_features.name: nullable
numeric_features.definition: 1 if SQL NULL is allowed; otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: primary_key
numeric_features.definition: 1 if field participates in the primary key; otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: foreign_key
numeric_features.definition: 1 if field participates in a declared foreign key; otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: unique_constraint
numeric_features.definition: 1 if field participates in a declared unique constraint, including composite keys; otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: text_like
numeric_features.definition: 1 for a supported text-like type family; otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: numeric_like
numeric_features.definition: 1 for a supported numeric type family; otherwise 0.

numeric_features.name: structured_like
numeric_features.definition: 1 for JSON/array/container type families; otherwise 0.

feature_contract.numeric_rules: All finite in [0,1]. Zero-denominator fractions are zero with missing/incomplete evidence flags. Profiling/parser implementation and thresholds are pinned in the feature-contract digest; this specification is not a deployed extractor.

training.sample_weighting: evaluate none versus training-only capped class weights
training.license_proposal: Apache-2.0 for project-owned code/weights; corpus rights independently reviewed
training.acquisition_scope: 100-family minimum is a review-only pilot, not auto-accept qualification

unmeasured_acceptance_targets.uncertainty_unit: application-family cluster resampling; binomial only when independence is defensible
